issue.title: [number field] Deduplicate steppers and simplify internals

labels.name: component: number field
labels.description: Changes related to the number field component.

issue.body:
Headless refactor of the Number Field internals.

## Changes

- **Deduplicate steppers**: the near-identical `NumberFieldIncrement`/`NumberFieldDecrement` now share a `useNumberFieldStepperButton` hook.
- **Internals tidy**:
  - `getStepAmount` typed `() => number`; dead `DEFAULT_STEP` fallbacks and the constant removed.
  - Remove dead `UseNumberFieldButton*` exports and unused `NumberFieldScrubAreaContext` fields.
  - Extract `isNumeralChar` and dedupe the plus/minus keydown handling; type `getAllowedNonNumericKeys` as `Set<string>`; derive the numeral-detection regexes from their arrays.
  - Rename `getViewportRect`'s misleading `width`/`height` to `right`/`bottom` (they're absolute edge coords).
  - Hoist static button/scrub/cursor style objects; drop a per-stepper `useMemo`.
  - Use the shared `stateAttributesMapping` directly; `Decrement` type-only import.
- **Validation coverage**: Added coverage for pre-round clamping with fractional bounds.
- **Comment/doc corrections**: `onValueChange` keyboard reason, `step="any"` modifier stepping, `teleportDistance`, `aria-roledescription`, `smallStep`/`largeStep` snapping.

review_comments.body: `onStop` now commits `lastChangedValueRef.current ?? valueRef.current`, but `lastChangedValueRef` is shared across interactions and can be non-null from a previous change. If the current press-and-hold sequence starts but the first `tick()` returns `false` (e.g. `step={0}` or a change gets canceled), `lastChangedValueRef.current` may still point at an older value and will be committed incorrectly. Reset `lastChangedValueRef.current` at the start of each press-and-hold sequence so the fallback reliably means “no tick changed the value in this interaction”.

## Pull request overview Headless refactor of the Number Field internals to reduce duplication between increment/decrement steppers, simplify validation/parsing helpers, and clarify scrub-area coordinate handling while keeping behavior consistent (with a few targeted fixes covered by new tests/docs). **Changes:** - Deduplicates increment/decrement stepper implementation via a shared `useNumberFieldStepperButton` hook and removes now-dead button-related exports/usages. - Simplifies/clarifies parsing and input handling (shared numeral detection, consolidated +/- sign handling, safer Infinity detection, tighter typing for `getAllowedNonNumericKeys` / `getStepAmount`). - Clarifies scrub-area viewport rect semantics (left/top/right/bottom) and hoists static style objects; adds tests/docs for edge-case behaviors (clamp-before-rounding, format prop updates, snapOnStep interactions). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 21 out of 21 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

adds `isNumeralChar`; simplifies parsing replacements and Infinity detection. | | packages/react/src/number-field/utils/getViewportRect.ts | Renames rect fields to `left/top/right/bottom` to reflect edge coordinates. | | packages/react/src/number-field/utils/constants.ts | Removes `DEFAULT_STEP` constant. | | packages/react/src/number-field/scrub-area/NumberFieldScrubAreaContext.ts | Removes unused scrub-area context fields. | | packages/react/src/number-field/scrub-area/NumberFieldScrubArea.tsx | Adopts new viewport-rect shape, removes DEFAULT_STEP fallback, hoists styles, and trims context payload. | | packages/react/src/number-field/scrub-area-cursor/NumberFieldScrubAreaCursor.tsx | Hoists cursor style object. | | packages/react/src/number-field/scrub-area-cursor/NumberFieldScrubAreaCursor.test.tsx | Updates test context shape to match removed context fields. | | packages/react/src/number-field/root/useNumberFieldStepperButton.ts | Introduces shared stepper button hook for increment/decrement. | | packages/react/src/number-field/root/useNumberFieldButton.ts | Removes DEFAULT_STEP fallback; improves dirty-text commit behavior before stepping; reuses shared touch-like detection. | | packages/react/src/number-field/root/NumberFieldRootContext.ts | Tightens typing of `getStepAmount` and `getAllowedNonNumericKeys`. | | packages/react/src/number-field/root/NumberFieldRoot.tsx | Refactors clamp/out-of-range logic readability; updates wheel listener comment; tightens step handling (`step="any"` base = 1). | | packages/react/src/number-field/root/NumberFieldRoot.test.tsx | Updates snap tests to use explicit `snapOnStep`; adds test for reformatting on `format` prop changes. | | packages/react/src/number-field/input/NumberFieldInput.tsx | Uses shared `isNumeralChar` and shared `stateAttributesMapping`; dedupes +/- handling. | | packages/react/src/number-field/input/NumberFieldInput.test.tsx | Renames tests for Home/End to reflect “set to min/max” behavior. | | packages/react/src/number-field/increment/NumberFieldIncrement.tsx | Replaces component logic with shared `useNumberFieldStepperButton`. | | packages/react/src/number-field/increment/NumberFieldIncrement.test.tsx | Adds regression test for avoiding snapped intermediate value before increment. | | packages/react/src/number-field/decrement/NumberFieldDecrement.tsx | Replaces component logic with shared `useNumberFieldStepperButton`. | | packages/react/src/internals/usePressAndHold.ts | Exports `isTouchLikePointerType` for reuse. | | docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/number-field/types.md | Updates docs to match reason semantics, step=\"any\" behavior, aria-roledescription clarifications, and button tag typo fixes. |

## Verdict: ✅ Clean. Approve.

No critical or important issues. This is a careful, behavior-preserving refactor with a few intentional, well-tested fixes. TypeScript checks clean.

## Critical Issues
None.

## Important Issues
None.

## Suggestions (all optional)

1. **`step="any"` interactive stepping is untested — and this PR now leans on it.** *(tests, criticality 6)* Removing `?? DEFAULT_STEP` makes the `step = stepProp === 'any' ? 1 : stepProp` resolution (`NumberFieldRoot.tsx:95`) load-bearing, but the only `step="any"` test covers form validation, not stepping. A regression in that resolution would fail no test. Suggest: `<NumberField defaultValue={5} step="any" />` → click Increase expects `'6'` (and Alt→`5.1`, Shift→`15`, which the new JSDoc now explicitly promises).

2. **Scrub-area pointer-lock `flushSync` removal is untested.** *(tests, criticality 4)* The removed nested `flushSync` relies on `onScrubbingChange` already flushing — verified correct by reading, but no test exercises the post-pointer-lock cursor path (Chromium-only, low value).

3. **Cosmetic: unused `catch (error)` binding** at `NumberFieldScrubArea.tsx:311` (pre-existing, not from this PR). Could be `catch {` to match line 163's style.

4. **Minor asymmetry now visible side-by-side in the shared hook:** `onStop` commits unconditionally while `onClick` commits only when `committed !== prev` (`useNumberFieldButton.ts:84` vs `:118`). Pre-existing and preserved — noting only because dedup put them adjacent.

## What was verified sound (the load-bearing changes)

- **Dropped `useMemo` for `buttonState`** in the new shared `useNumberFieldStepperButton` — safe; `useRenderElement` never uses `state` identity, and a fresh object per render is the established pattern.
- **`commitValue` no-direction + `!details.isCanceled` guard** — the intended fix; avoids a spurious directionally-snapped intermediate and correctly steps from the applied (not rejected) base. New test at `NumberFieldIncrement.test.tsx:397` **was confirmed to fail when the fix is reverted**.
- **`getStepAmount: () => number`** and all `?? DEFAULT_STEP` removals — every path returns a finite number (including `step="any"`→1); the guards were already dead code.
- **`validate.ts` two-pass clamp** — both clamps genuinely needed for non-integer bounds; new test at `validate.test.ts:547` **uniquely covers** the before-rounding pass (fails only when that clamp is removed).
- **`parse.ts`** — `{ regex: groupRegex }` is equivalent (groupRegex is null when group is falsy), `input.includes('∞')` ≡ the old regex, DETECT_REs derived from arrays have no TDZ issue.
- **`getViewportRect` width/height→right/bottom** rename — all branches and the sole consumer updated consistently.
- **ScrubArea context field removals** and **`[minWithDefault, formatStyle]`→`[minWithDefault]`** dep change — no remaining consumers / no stale closure.
- **All 10 modified comments/JSDoc audited accurate** — no comment rot introduced.

## Strengths
- Genuine duplication elimination (two near-identical steppers → one shared hook), directly advancing the "avoid duplicating logic" guideline.
- The risky behavior fixes each ship with a dedicated regression test that the analyzer empirically confirmed fails without the fix.
- High-quality "why over what" comments paired with locking tests; docs (`types.md`) and JSDoc updated together.

## Recommended action
Mergeable as-is. If you want to harden it, add the `step="any"` stepping test (suggestion #1) — that's the one real coverage hole and it's now load-bearing.
